title: Architecture map
summary: How a scan moves through Recon: one reactor thread owns the scan sockets, and a bounded worker pool does service detection.
basis: Source: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and src/ in recon 2.1.0.

nodes.label: CLI and options
nodes.desc: Parses flags, applies a scan profile (explicit flags always override it) and prints an authorization notice.

nodes.label: Target resolver
nodes.desc: Expands IPv4, IPv6, hostnames and CIDR ranges (with a host cap). Targets from -iL files are read by the option parser and resolved the same way.

nodes.label: Scan orchestrator
nodes.desc: Creates (host, port) tasks in port-major order and drives the chosen scan engine.

nodes.label: epoll reactor
nodes.desc: One thread multiplexes up to max-inflight non-blocking sockets. Handles connect completion, deadlines, retries, token-bucket rate limiting, back-off on fd exhaustion and cancellation.
notes: Serves both TCP connect and UDP scans.
Nothing else touches the scan sockets.

nodes.label: SYN scanner
nodes.desc: Raw-socket half-open scan. Each probe uses a random sequence number and only replies acknowledging it are believed.
notes: Does not parse ICMP unreachables, so blocked ports time out as filtered.

nodes.label: Bounded queue
nodes.desc: Open TCP ports wait here for detection. Capacity is 4 x workers, so the producer blocks when it is full and memory stays bounded.

nodes.label: Worker pool and probe engine
nodes.desc: Waits for a passive banner, then sends active probes ordered by port hint and rarity. Fresh connection per probe, hard time budget per port, first confident match wins.

nodes.label: Protocol matchers
nodes.desc: Pure functions from bytes to an optional detection. Every offset goes through a bounds-checked reader; fuzzed under ASan and UBSan.

nodes.label: TLS inspection
nodes.desc: Optional certificate inspection, compiled only when OpenSSL is available.

nodes.label: UDP matchers
nodes.desc: Parse DNS, NTP and NetBIOS replies received by the reactor.

nodes.label: Result store
nodes.desc: Mutex-guarded. Closed and filtered ports are counted, not stored, so a full-range scan does not allocate 65,535 records.

nodes.label: OS inference
nodes.desc: Aggregates evidence rather than fingerprinting. TTL-only evidence is capped at 40 to 50 percent confidence.

nodes.label: Output layer
nodes.desc: Table, strict-UTF-8 JSON and CSV (with a formula-injection guard), plus the process exit code.

nodes.label: Baseline and drift
nodes.desc: A strict, depth-limited JSON parser loads a previous report. Drift is computed only over hosts and ports the current scan covered; new open ports give exit code 5.
